places-arco-ii-abrigo-del-canto-blanco.story: 101 km from Calasparra to Calasparra, about 1 h 44 of riding. It goes by way of Los Grajos I, Abrigo del Canto Blanco and back through Los Grajos I. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
